title: National Lok Adalat Traffic Challan Settlement Framework
statutory_basis: Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987 (Sections 19, 20, 21); Section 200 Motor Vehicles Act, 1988
authority: National Legal Services Authority (NALSA) & State Legal Services Authorities (SLSAs)
award_finality: Section 21 Legal Services Authorities Act: Award of Lok Adalat is deemed a decree of civil court; no appeal lies against the compromise award.

quarterly_calendar.description: First National Lok Adalat of the calendar year across all High Courts and District Courts.
Second National Lok Adalat focusing on compoundable traffic offences and summary disputes.
Third National Lok Adalat before the festive season.
Final National Lok Adalat of the year for pending traffic challan clearances.

Karnataka.notes: Karnataka Government orders have historically provided a flat 50% discount on pending traffic challans during Lok Adalats.

Delhi.notes: DSLSA issues online token booking for designated court complexes (Tis Hazari, Saket, Patiala House, Karkardooma, Rohini, Dwarka).

Maharashtra.notes: High rate of compounding disposal for two-wheeler and commercial goods carriage minor violations.

Uttar Pradesh.notes: Concessions applied across all district courts under Chief Judicial Magistrate supervision.

Tamil Nadu.slsa_name: Tamil Nadu State Legal Services Authority (TNSLSA)
Tamil Nadu.notes: High settlement rates for helmet, seatbelt, and signal compliance notices.

Gujarat.notes: Matches state Section 200 reduced compounding rates with additional court fee waivers.

DEFAULT.notes: General NALSA recommendation: 50% concession bracket for non-hazardous compoundable traffic offences.
